why: A superscript 2 or 3 after a single letter or CO, NO, SO, km, cm or mm is an exponent or part of a name and stays a plain digit: m2, m3, km2, CO2, H2, E2 Singapore, I2R, L3 and the Malay body M3 are what the corpus prints this way.
title: Sample Question
html:
Mr A: Flats of 90 m2 use 12 m3 of water over 5 km2.

Emissions of CO2 and H2 fell.

E2 Singapore, I2R losses, L3 and M3 work together.
